title: Derivatives & Curve Sketching
description: Differentiation rules, tangents, extrema and inflection points.
html:
📈 Derivatives & Curve Sketching

1. Derivative

$$f'(a) = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{f(a + h) - f(a)}{h}, \qquad \text{tangent: } y = f(a) + f'(a)(x - a)$$

2. Differentiation rules

$$(x^n)' = nx^{n-1}, \quad (e^x)' = e^x, \quad (\ln x)' = \tfrac{1}{x}, \quad (\sin x)' = \cos x, \quad (\cos x)' = -\sin x$$

Sum, product, quotient, chain

$$(af + bg)' = af' + bg', \quad (uv)' = u'v + uv', \quad \left(\tfrac{u}{v}\right)' = \tfrac{u'v - uv'}{v^2}, \quad (f(g))' = f'(g)\,g'$$

Typical mistakes

  • $(uv)' \neq u'v'$
  • Chain rule: forgetting the inner derivative, e.g. $(\sin 3x)' = 3\cos 3x$
  • $(\cos x)' = -\sin x$ – don't forget the minus

3. Curve sketching

  • $f' > 0$: rising, $f' < 0$: falling
  • Extremum: $f'(x_0) = 0$ and $f''(x_0) \neq 0$; $f'' < 0$ maximum, $f'' > 0$ minimum
  • Inflection point: $f''(x_w) = 0$ and $f'''(x_w) \neq 0$

$$f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 9x: \quad H(1, 4), \ T(3, 0), \ W(2, 2)$$

4. Optimisation

Set up the objective function, substitute the constraint, solve $A'(x) = 0$, check the type (second derivative) and boundary values, answer in a sentence.
